item.title: Chris Stapleton “Tennesse Whiskey” Goes Double Diamond
item.description: Chris Stapleton’s “Tennessee Whiskey” has become the first country song certified double diamond. Chris Stapleton’s “Tennessee Whiskey” has been certified RIAA Double Diamond with over 20 million units sold—the first country song ever to reach this milestone.
